page_title: LEC 0-1 JUV | Lecce v Juventus 09/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Federico Gatti (Juventus) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wladimiro Falcone.
90+3' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) wastes a huge opportunity after receiving a fine cross from the free kick, but his close-range shot goes well over the crossbar.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
86' Weston McKennie goes off the pitch and Federico Gatti (Juventus) comes on.
83' Luciano Spalletti prepares a substitution. Francisco Conceicao is replaced by Edon Zhegrova (Juventus).
83' The manager makes a subsitution with Jonathan David (Juventus) coming on for Andrea Cambiaso.
83' Substitution. Jeremie Boga (Juventus) in, Kenan Yildiz out.
82' Gaby Jean (Lecce) has too much to say to the referee and is cautioned.
80' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
79' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) leaps highest to meet the resulting set piece and sends his header way off target.
79' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
77' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Dusan Vlahovic walks off the pitch to be replaced by Emil Holm (Juventus).
77' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) slips past a defender on the edge of the box and hits a shot at goal that rises just over the bar.
76' Here is a change. Lameck Banda is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Konan Ndri (Lecce).
76' Substitution. Walid Cheddira did his best and is replaced by Francesco Camarda (Lecce).
74' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Juventus comes to nothing.

73' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Juventus will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
72' Weston McKennie (Juventus) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Wladimiro Falcone.
71' Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Michele Di Gregorio is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
70' Substitution. Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce) has come on for Danilo Veiga.
70' Golden opportunity! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass.
64' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) leaps highest to meet the resulting corner and attempts to head home, but the effort goes harmlessly wide of the left post.
63' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
62' Oumar Ngom comes off the pitch to be replaced by Gaby Jean (Lecce).
62' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Juventus due to an offside in the build-up play.
61' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the Juventus goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

59' It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Pierre Kalulu (Juventus). Andrea Cambiaso plays a fantastic through ball and finds Pierre Kalulu (Juventus), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
56' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) has to stretch for the ball in the box and sends it well wide of the right post.
56' A pass from Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) is intercepted by Wladimiro Falcone and the move breaks down.
54' Weston McKennie (Juventus) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
51' One of the players from Lecce times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
50' The goal by Juventus won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
50' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Juventus players aren’t happy.
48' Goal! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
46' The whistle blows and Andrea Colombo starts the second half.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
42' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
39' Close! Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) unleashes a rocket of a shot from the edge of the box and his shot flies just a few inches over the crossbar.
38' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Juventus was in an offside position.
38' Juventus have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

37' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Juventus.
36' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

36' Dusan Vlahovic receives a sweet cross inside the box from Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
34' Lecce try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
34' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Lecce will take a free kick near the side line.
31' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation.
27' A long pass, executed by Weston McKennie (Juventus), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
26' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) heads on.
25' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
23' Bremer (Juventus) misses a big chance! He fires the ball high over the crossbar from inside the 6-yard box after the ball rebounded to him.
22' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

20' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
16' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) unleashes a decent effort from just outside the box which goes narrowly wide of the left post.
11' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
11' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
10' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Good work from Juventus as they win a corner.
6' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
6' Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Wladimiro Falcone.
5' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

5' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' OFF THE POST! Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) picks up the ball inside the box and produces a snap shot which smashes against the right post.
3' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) receives a great pass inside the box and misses a golden chance. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save.

1' 0 - 1 Andrea Cambiaso sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Dusan Vlahovic (Juventus) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 0:1.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Juventus will kick-off.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
Show lineups
Today's referee will be Andrea Colombo.
